annotations.title: List properties found for a property watch

description: Use this when the user asks what LivinIsto has found for an intent created with intent_publish_intent. These are the same properties LivinIsto e-mails to the user; this server cannot send messages into the conversation by itself. Requires the intentCode; optional since (ISO time) returns only newer matches. Returns at most 20 newest matches with the price and LivinIsto price verdict (per m², against comparable properties nearby) at the time of the match and a link. Before the user confirms the intent there are no matches. Matches come from listings LivinIsto aggregates from the market, so they cover only properties listed on LivinIsto and may be incomplete; a property may already be sold or rented.

since.description: Only matches found after this ISO time.

name: intent_list_matches

priceEur.description: Asking price today; per month for a rental. Null when the listed number is not the price of the whole property (a share, an auction, a short stay) — check the listing.

roomOnly.description: True when the rent is for a room in a shared flat, not the whole flat.

title.description: Built from LivinIsto's own fields (type, rooms, place), never the seller's headline.

url.description: Link to the property on www.livinisto.sk — show it unchanged.

more.description: More matches exist than returned; call again with since.

status.description: awaiting_consent = the user has not confirmed on the LivinIsto page yet; awaiting_email_confirmation = the user filled in the page and must click the link in the e-mail; active = LivinIsto is watching; expired = the confirmation link, the buy-by date or the intent's validity ran out; withdrawn = cancelled.

title: List properties found for a property watch
